# Antigravity 2.0 Korean Translator (`v2.0.0` · Desktop Native Only)

Clean-slate desktop-only Korean translation plugin for Antigravity 2.0:
- Real-time Thinking (reasoning) Korean translation with code/identifier protection and Korean particle correction.
- Static English UI Korean localization with strict exclusion of code viewers, diff lines, terminals, inputs, and agent response bodies.
- Official Antigravity Sidecar (`AUX_PANE`) settings and diagnostics panel (`sidecars/ko-translator-settings/`).
- Isolated drop-in loader (`~/.gemini/antigravity/ui-extensions.d/ko-thought-translator.json`) with live `config.json` `enabled` gate and atomic `--rollback`.
